rules: successful collaboration may increase professional respect without friendship.
support/confidences may improve trust/affinity only in the represented direction.
friendship_develops requires familiarity >= acquainted plus at least two positive shared-history refs.
close_friendship_develops requires current friendship_state=friend plus additional positive history.
conflict may create tension and reduce trust/affinity; it does not automatically create permanent hostility.
apology may move active conflict toward repairing but cannot erase the conflict event.
accepted reconciliation may produce reconciled_unresolved_history and partial trust repair.
romantic_interest_emergence is directional, adult heterosexual canon-gated and cause-provenance gated.
romantic_expression does not create reciprocal interest.
romantic_rejection has no automatic hostility effect.
completed_date records shared romantic history but does not automatically establish partnership.
reciprocal_commitment requires bilateral confirmation and compatible reciprocal romantic state.
separation changes relationship state but preserves all prior shared history.
